comparison.objective: Taper training-head hair with clipper-over-comb at four target lengths.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual curved-surface tool coordination with irreversible cut-depth control.
comparison.success_condition: All tufts meet row-specific lengths, no bald patch or ear contact occurs, and tools are returned.
comparison.reason: It tests irreversible cutting regulated by a comb, not setting and locking an articulated device.
